name: Omarchy Light Sync for Hue
author: Sven Wagener
description: Synchronizes Philips Hue Entertainment areas with your screen, like an ambilight. Runs entirely inside the Omarchy shell: no daemon, no extra packages, no cloud. Screen capture only starts when you start synchronization.

barWidget.description: Hue Entertainment screen sync. Left click opens the panel; right click starts or stops synchronization.

schema.label: Show while synchronization is idle
schema.description: Errors and active synchronization remain visible when this is off.
